description: Edit an incident's title, status, impact, components, or publish/unpublish/archive it. Only the fields you pass change. To tell readers what is happening, use post_incident_update instead. Owners and admins only.

archived.description: true files it away and marks it resolved.

component_ids.description: The status page components affected (ids from get_status_page). Replaces the whole set.

published.description: true makes the incident public on the status page. Only when the user asks.

title.description: Headline shown on the status page.

name: update_incident
title: Update an incident
